Later corrections require coverage beyond known v3.1 issues. The user does perceive some installed-v3.1 influence and recalls stronger pre-Accord automatic verified handoff and ongoing correction. Preserve this as reported experience, not measured causal runtime benefit or a zero-value finding. Size reduction must preserve necessary functionality and user experience; runtime retirement is not a goal. On 2026-09-05 the user additionally authorized upgrading their existing host-installed Accord packages after 3.2 is accepted and published. That initial upgrade direction was limited to the post-release package. On 2026-09-06 the user explicitly required user authorization for task archival and authorized the successor task to investigate and repair this handoff failure, then continue the existing 3.2 work. Handoff, completion, task creation and resource cleanup do not grant archive authority; no archive is authorized in this continuation. Later the user clarified that necessary configuration adjustments can be prepared and carried out with backups and rollback, rather than forcing an increasingly complex zero-change test route. Bind the actual settings, affected sessions, prior state, restoration and verification; the user then explicitly allowed installing the existing Codex candidate before publication, with development interference controlled and a verified backup/recovery path. This permits the bounded Accord transition already proposed, not host application upgrades or unrelated extension changes. The user also directed removal of dedicated host planning-mode prompts and their bindings from current v3.1-and-later surfaces, preserving earlier versions. Current intent and authority govern; plans, procedures and acceptance adapt to justified corrections and evidence, and the native progress UI maps the current plan without becoming task authority. The user subsequently withdrew the pre-release shared-host installation route to reduce development self-interference and unpredictable propagation. The existing Codex candidate is to remain uninstalled until an accepted release; bounded task-local exposure may support necessary evaluation. Prior installation/rollback observations remain historical facts, not standing authorization to reinstall. Hot-update behavior depends on the host and requires observed activation/recovery; replacing files cannot undo prior conversation influence.

conditionalRelease.rule: Prepare and publish the accepted 3.2 candidate under this bound user direction. Commit and push the complete in-scope candidate before publication; bind hosted checks and the new release to the same immutable SHA and exclude unrelated dirty work. This intent is not present readiness. Resolve a materially new cost, trust, data or destructive effect before it occurs; do not rewrite prior releases or repeatedly ask the user to reconfirm this same direction. The user requires README and changelog finalization after implementation and acceptance stabilize, followed by global alignment of source intent, implementation, acceptance, package/version identity and release claims.

authority.rule: This records the bound user decision; it cannot manufacture authority for another goal or effect. Later corrections can revise the development design.

baselineRole: The exact predecessor in Git preserves historical semantics and evidence. Current copies of its constitution, program, acceptance and reshaping guidance remove the user-retired dedicated host planning prompt and its dependent constraints; fixed before/after identities permit only this reviewed deletion. Golden Tasks and all other historical content remain intact. This successor governs current development and replaces conflicting historical prescriptions. Ordinary goals, authorization, planning, verification and recovery remain responsibilities; no host planning or scheduling mechanism governs them.

cycle.scopeRule: Preserve necessary outcomes; review each inherited function and mechanism for actual need. Delegate to suitable host capabilities; compare maintained alternatives for a material gap or plausible net benefit, not only native failure. Merge or retire unnecessary assets with callers and acceptance reconciled. Keep existing Codex/Claude scope before expanding hosts. Development is not candidate acceptance or publication; review compatibility before final version selection.
cycle.sourceDecision: The approved source semantics are carried forward in this open development successor. A development commit records code identity, not an accepted source-phase closeout or release receipt.

delivery.rule: Unpublished dev.9 prioritizes required decision checks and bounded failure convergence after the dev.8 management Agent repeatedly exhausted its turn limit. Required confirmation, actual post-state before retry, premise/necessity review, authorized recovery and independent safe work remain; unchanged denied retries do not justify bypass. Native package source checks, installed/loading verification and a surviving recovery actor remain required. The preserved dev.8 episode includes successful selected installed activation but no completed guarded-update or independent recovery result. This text change requires fresh affected behavior evidence. Both Skills remain under 8800 bytes without new runtime files; historical observations keep their exact subjects. Shared candidate installation remains deferred until accepted publication.

hostProjections.activationContext: SessionStart compact or resume supplies non authoritative model and permission hints only. Re sense decision relevant state from supported official sources. Missing or conflicting fields remain unknown. Preserve the independently bound last safe allocation. Use a fresh zero history destination only when required. Deliver and confirm takeover before source allocation release. Task archival requires explicit user authorization. Startup and clear stay silent. Invalid input fails visibly without echoing input. Hints prove neither current task state nor authority, Agent use, execution, effect, evidence or value.

changeBoundary.rule: This open successor carries the current implementation slice and its generated visible plan; revise this bounded surface as authorized functional work proceeds. The predecessor remains closed at its immutable revision. Check actual changed and untracked paths, not the predecessor's completed presentation transition.

complexityBudget.rationale: On 2026-09-06 the user approved a 1150000-byte code/test ceiling to preserve necessary failure regressions and at least five-percent headroom. The current tree measures 1087797 code/test bytes, leaving 62203 below the ceiling and 4703 beyond the required 57500 reserve. Limits remain 126 tracked files and 28000 primary instruction bytes; dev.9 keeps 126 files, both Skills are 8761 bytes under 8800, and actual primary instructions are 24164 bytes. Python modules and product tests are counted here; review PowerShell observation code separately. Cost conformance does not qualify host behavior or value; remeasure final candidates before admission.

source.purpose: Drive the host and Agent to fulfill responsibilities needed for an authorized outcome. Reuse available host resources and maintained alternatives; compose or build when justified by required effects and total lifecycle burden. Own supported mechanics across functions, settings, configuration, interaction, resources, context, handoff and lifecycle. Human decision authority is distinct from manual operation; preserve intervention and revocation. Visible controls are not automatically actionable or authorized. No unmeasured majority-of-controls claim is made. Reduce avoidable user orchestration, correction and recovery; owning every implementation is not the product goal. Machine-suited representations, parallelism and automation may serve human goals without imitating human work routines. Judge them by observable effect, relevant lookup and adaptation cost, evidence, inspectability and necessary human control, not assumed machine superiority. Accord owns the collaboration policy between user intent, host capabilities and surrounding extensions. Customizable environments are ordinary operating conditions, not an excuse for drift. Across every necessary duty, retain the control needed to preserve user-owned goals and authority, reconcile relevant variables, validate claims and reach the promised failure post-state. Host mechanisms may implement delegated operations, but their mere availability cannot discharge Accord’s declared responsibility. Noncommercial open source does not lower the agreed industrial or commercial production delivery standard; that standard requires concrete effect, compatibility, recoverability and maintenance evidence, not a label or a certification claim.
source.hypothesis: Context-selected intervention can improve bounded outcomes and total collaboration burden. A correct design, isolated success or safe stop alone does not establish that incremental value.
source.bootstrapBoundary: Bootstrap through an available, authorized host entry and observable conditions. Reuse supported discovery, execution, state and recovery; Accord intervention need not supply a duplicate executor or runtime. Add only justified missing means or material improvement. Injection or self-bootstrapping creates neither authority, hidden-state access, physical feasibility nor a surviving recovery actor after all components fail. Retire redundant assets after checking callers, still-needed effects and affected acceptance; historical receipts keep their original scope. Accord is an open collaboration layer across host and extension boundaries, not a universal proxy or a new authority above them. Resolve conflicts by authenticated origin, applicable scope, freshness and explicit authorization, never by installation order, text volume or capability presence. Host-enforced limits remain limits; extension output is evidence or advice, not user authorization. Hook guards cover only supported observed paths; uncovered paths cannot inherit their guarantee.

globalInvariants.meaning: Respect applicable obligations and safety boundaries, human-owned authority, privacy and ownership, and truthful evidence and claims. No route, policy change or success definition may waive these boundaries.

source.boundCommitment: The authorized goal, required functions, quality, accepted risk and result criteria are binding within their named task and revision. They are not permanent global constants, but the Agent cannot silently relax them to fit an available mechanism. A legitimate change revises the bound commitment explicitly and invalidates affected acceptance.

successStates.responsibilities-accounted: Every required responsibility has an explicit disposition and support or an honest gap; this is accounting, not functional success.
successStates.function-verified: A named function achieves its required observable effect through an available normal entry in an exact supported composition, including relevant failure and lifecycle conditions.
successStates.outcome-complete: Every necessary bound result and applicable post-state condition is sufficiently verified; unknown or failed necessary results prevent completion.
successStates.safely-stopped: Further effects are safely bounded while the missing result, authority or feasibility is disclosed; safe stopping does not fulfill an unmet functional commitment.
successStates.value-supported: Suitable evidence supports the claimed improvement after accounting for total intervention, evaluator, user, recovery and lifecycle cost; comparative claims require a valid comparison.

classes.compliance: Global boundary; context determines which concrete obligations apply, not whether compliance can be waived.
classes.commitment: Applies to the explicitly bound goal, scope and revision until legitimately changed.
classes.strategy: Applies only when its conditions are supported in the current task; it may be composed, replaced or retired.

applicability.unknown: Resolve only decision-relevant uncertainty. Hold the dependent consequential action when necessary; an unknown field does not automatically block unrelated safe work or shrink the promised functionality.
applicability.conflict: Preserve compliance, reconcile the latest legitimate bound commitment, then compare applicable strategies. A local success, failure or host label cannot activate a rule globally.
applicability.representation: These are semantic responsibilities, not mandatory per-message records or a fixed workflow. Reuse supported host state; materialize only the information needed for the current decision.

implementation.runtimeRequirement: 不预设必须依赖独立运行时，也不预设无运行时足够。按所需可靠性绑定触发者、实际执行者、必要状态载体和故障后的接管者，再判断宿主原生机制、Hook、脚本、Skill 或其它对象的组合是否兑现；一轮任务可只需宿主现有 Agent 循环和上下文。对确定触发、强制约束、跨轮状态、无人值守推进或故障后继续执行，核验实际职责与效果，而非用对象名称代替判断。仅在现有组合确有执行、状态或恢复缺口时补足相应机制，包括有依据的持久运行时。Skill 是可解释指导，不是独立调度器或强制执行保证；历史良好体验也不能单独归因于运行时。任何组合仍须验收普通入口、失败及独立后态。
implementation.rule: Compare native, maintained, composed and authored means on evidenced functional and quality sufficiency, context fit and total lifecycle burden. Native means are a low-burden starting point or equivalent-fit preference, not a veto on superior external means. A runtime is eligible when its execution, state or recovery properties fit the need; no form must be built and fail first. Reuse sufficient host discovery and execution rather than duplicate them. For every duty distinguish user-owned decisions, Accord-owned policy/control/state/verification, and host-supplied execution or facilities. Borrowing an operation does not outsource dependency validation, drift response or the declared outcome. Implement machine-checkable consequential controls through an actual delivered caller where needed; text and an uncalled maintainer core cannot substitute for that effect. Preserve useful customization, localize conflicts and recover within observed host limits; do not promise arbitrary broken-host compatibility or silently require a pristine environment.

modelSelection.trigger: A task or bounded subtask needs a model/effort choice, or relevant requirements, capabilities, permissions, quotas or effects change. Do not rematch every turn without a material reason.
modelSelection.selection: Within currently authorized and available candidates, match task difficulty, risk, modalities, tools, context, latency, cost and quality floors. Seek best supported fit, not an unverifiable global optimum or a fixed brand ranking.
modelSelection.authority: Honor explicit user model/effort selections and restrictions. Selection does not authorize a new provider, data transfer, account or material cost. Do not invent unsupported parent-model hot switching or delegation.
modelSelection.nativeReplacement: Reuse native task/subagent model parameters, defaults, inheritance and supported routing when sufficient. Remove duplicate Accord selection/dispatch implementation only when the same required matching, execution and adaptation are closed; retain accountability for an unmet need.
modelSelection.verification: Bind task need, allowed candidate facts, chosen route and actual host-reported execution model/effort when exposed. Reconcile provider aliases, inherited or substituted models, quality and total lifecycle cost. A request parameter, listing or name is not proof of backend identity or optimality; hold unavailable facts unknown.
modelSelection.failureOracle: Reject unsupported automatic-switch claims, silent replacement of a pinned model, quality loss disguised as cost savings, default inheritance mistaken for task matching, unobserved subagent execution, or duplicated native routing without a demonstrated gap.

implementation.triggerRule: A user request, supported lifecycle signal, relevant state change or just-in-time decision may trigger the chain. Eventless hosts can re-sense at material boundaries. No Hook or pure-core invocation is universally required.
implementation.nativeRule: Native or composed implementation counts when it fulfills the same duty; no Accord-owned code is required. Availability is not observed execution. Leave a sufficient low-burden route alone when no decision-relevant improvement warrants comparison; native sufficiency alone does not close discovery or prove incremental Accord value. Count current model reasoning, decomposition, selection, correction and delegation as well as host interfaces. Reassess after material change and retire intervention that no longer earns its cost, preserving still-needed effects. This does not waive Accord-owned control: an interpretive policy may use the Agent where its required reliability is demonstrated; a promised deterministic guard needs an actual enforceable entry and verified coverage. Do not infer trust or user consent from caller-supplied labels.
implementation.reconstructionRule: Review the entire required chain before local optimization: need and trigger, current facts and selection, execution and state, failure ownership, result verification and attributable cleanup. Skill, Hook, pure core, runtime, their quantity and connections may be retained, split, merged, replaced or removed. Choose each change by end-to-end sufficiency and total burden, not inherited packaging or a minimum-file target. Replace a broken premise or chain from its earliest affected dependency boundary, including full redesign where justified; reconcile affected design, package admission, procedures and acceptance while preserving unrelated user state and historical evidence. Indexes and graphs are optional representations, not required outcomes or proof of closure. Compare actual callers, decision quality and query speed against construction, refresh, staleness, resource and maintenance cost. Use direct queries or sufficient host means when appropriate; derive a view only when it earns its cost. Retire a redundant representation without losing necessary relationships or effects.

supportingPrinciples.precondition: Safety, compliance and the full bound functional and quality commitment constrain these strategies. They optimize how the commitment is fulfilled; they cannot silently reduce it.
supportingPrinciples.subtraction: Remove duplication, ineffective work or displaced mechanisms only while preserving required effects, user experience and applicable failure coverage. Smaller code, fewer dependencies or less persistent state are not improvements if necessary orchestration or recovery work returns to the user.
supportingPrinciples.restraint: Avoid unnecessary intervention and complexity; invest in sufficient mechanisms, including a runtime, when required by the result.
supportingPrinciples.fallback: Contain failure and preserve a safe state, then own the feasible authorized recovery path. If the result remains unmet, disclose the gap; a safe stop is not functional completion.
supportingPrinciples.gapFilling: Supply or compose the exact capability or coordination missing from the current environment, then reassess its need when native conditions change.
supportingPrinciples.activation: Select the relevant strategy by the present duty, observed gap and failure consequences. No strategy must run on every task, and none is a product-wide prohibition on implementation.

capabilityMap.representation: One versioned semantic source owns outcomes and evidence requirements; workSequence owns procedures and exits. Duty ids join the review views without a second authority. Indexes, graphs, matrices and caches are replaceable representations justified by actual consumers and decision or maintenance benefit, not required product modules. Direct task-time queries may suffice. dependsOn is implementation-order review, not a live feedback or execution graph. This dated inventory is not every vendor or host/model/tool combination; model, host and composed capability remain distinct.
capabilityMap.refreshRule: At a relevant decision, inspect the running client, actual provider/model, policy and exposed interface. Version/feature/configuration/package/permission changes, a supported invalidation event, source contradiction, missing observation or failed effect reopen affected applicability. Re-read supported state and only the needed official documentation; no automatic network watcher or fixed global expiry is installed. Retain the dated observation as history, never as permanently current support.
capabilityMap.allocationRule: Allocate by bound effects, evidence, fit and full adoption/use/recovery/exit cost. Reuse host discovery and lifecycle; compare beyond installed tools for a material gap or plausible net benefit. Native preference resolves comparable fit, not a better external candidate. Retire verified duplicates; a necessary duty survives implementation retirement, while an unnecessary duty needs revised need and acceptance. Symbiosis is a goal, not value evidence.
capabilityMap.runtimeGap: The current host Skill supplies adaptive guidance, not a proven system executor. Historical dev.2 native repair and same-session resume observations do not qualify this candidate, incremental value, surviving failure ownership, zero-history handoff or package lifecycle. closure.py remains a no-I/O reference core: callers supply candidates and comparison facts; it does not discover tools or establish their truth. Keeping that reference outside the ordinary entry is not itself a defect. The uncalled simulated graph demonstration has been retired from the current tree; its historical paths resolve at their original revisions. Needed discovery, decisions and effects still require sufficient observable host or composed execution. The demonstrated gap spans ownership and delivery, not only dynamic adaptation: no ordinary-entry caller currently connects the reference decisions to fresh sources, affected-state updates and executed post-state. Review the necessary control allocation across all duties and implement the smallest real path before claiming production sufficiency. A simple order-file diagnostic does not close customized-environment adaptation or that allocation.

systemOptimization.rule: Derive the applicable floor for each required system quality from the bound result and risk. A failed or unknown required floor cannot be offset by speed, low cost, code reduction or a high average score elsewhere. Explicitly justify non-applicability; it does not remove product responsibilities. Optimize the weakest consequential dependency first and check its affected consumers. Baseline, plan shape, procedures and acceptance are revisable hypotheses within the bound goal. At material counterevidence or host change, revise only affected source and consumers, retain prior exact evidence as history, and explain the changed acceptance. Do not preserve a step count or mechanism merely to keep the original plan. Human and Agent understanding is provisional: alignment, research, planning, execution and review are conditional responsibilities, not a mandatory sequence or complete-specification gate. Continue safe work from current sufficient agreement; revisit only decisions affected by material uncertainty, changed needs or evidence. Any changed goal, authority or acceptance must be reconciled explicitly, never used to conceal an unmet commitment. Each applicable quality floor must be mapped to execution stages as well as listed; these many-to-many links are reviewable allocations, not a universal SOP or evidence that the floor has passed. Current user intent and authority govern. Plans, procedures and acceptance are revisable with explicit reasons; the native progress view maps the current plan. A scheduler or presentation tool cannot become a mandatory execution dependency. Correct or pause affected work when later intent, authority or evidence conflicts. Prefer repeatable checks for testable, risk-relevant constraints and challenge critical checks with known failures or bounded mutation/fault injection. Retain authorized intent, rationale and unencoded requirements; tools and metrics may encode wrong or incomplete expectations. Use independent observable post-state, not Agent-authored QA or a score as ground truth. Verify supported enforcement at consequential action boundaries before claiming prevention; guidance alone cannot supply it. Select metrics, mutation scope and reviewer topology by the actual risk and lifecycle cost; no universal score, Gherkin format or five-role pipeline is required. Revise checks transparently when their premises change, preserving prior counterevidence.

workSequence.exit: 同一公开入口区分必需功能声明闭合与整版资格；漏范围、删用例、跨宿主拼半套或换入口/环境不能掩盖缺口。继续拒绝旧定义、来源不足、过期/漂移、跨事件或矛盾后态、未闭合残留及缺失独立评审。合成回归仅验证准入器；真实范围、判据充分性和来源接入仍未完成，授权、精确推送、托管及公共后态独立成立。

workSequence.title: 整体执行链、原生覆盖与遗留形态审查
workSequence.procedure: 用无需内部操作术语的真实需求验证普通入口交付与用户负担，并与适用原生基线比较；主动发现未列出的设计盲区和跨功能断点。按需论证目标、手段、可行条件和授权，证据足够即进入下一安全实现或核验。沿触发、发现与比较、执行及状态、故障接管、验收和清理检查整体连接；原生是起点而非停止规则，缺口或可信净收益机会才扩展检索，复用足够的宿主发现与执行链。自举同理。检查资产必要性、调用者、过期导航与维护负担，按证据保留、合并、替换或退役；同步受影响声明、工序和验收，历史证据不改写，功能不降格。
workSequence.exit: 必要端到端链路和适用故障后态兑现；局部功能 PASS、指令加载或评估器代劳不能代替整体完成。若改变形态，应有配套入口、依赖、执行者与精确包验证。

workSequence.title: Accord 对 Agent 的净影响、干扰与故障验收
workSequence.procedure: 以 Accord 对 Agent 的实际影响为主问题，按声明选择同条件原生对照、最小可交付组合与受控混合环境。先核实各臂实际插件、Skill、Hook 及其他注入，避免旧版污染对照；先比较交付、授权、必要检查与正常收束，再核算额外 Token、耗时、无效探索、人工补救和残留，Token 增量本身不等于净副作用。宿主查询写缓存和模型条件变化只是局部诊断，不能代替项目影响的因果判断。同一被测执行/状态变化联合核验适用纠正、恢复及资源后态，实际跨载体或来源转移才核验目的端与来源释放，不强制交接。精确包安装前和卸载后由仍可用的生命周期执行者承担；不依赖评估器救援或被移除的 Skill。
workSequence.exit: 普通入口产生可独立观察的效果；正向外援、负向干扰及评估器救援均被识别；所需功能与后置状态全部有证据，不能取平均掩盖短板。

workSequence.title: 3.2 定版、发布与收尾
workSequence.procedure: 依据已建立的当前证据准入通路计算候选资格，不将静态 PASS 当作功能验收。复核资产必要性与受影响功能，实现与验收稳定后，按实际变更及其因果统一更新 README.md、README.zh-CN.md 和 CHANGELOG.md，并检查源头、实现、验收、包、版本与发布说明的全局一致性；提交并推送完整候选，核对精确包、独立评审与托管检查，再依已有条件授权发布新的 3.2。发布后按用户新增授权，盘点其现有 Codex/Claude 中 Accord 的安装来源及共享关系，经受支持的宿主或实际管理器将已安装 Accord 升至该精确版本；先确认备份和可用回退路径，保护配置、模型路线、其他扩展及正在运行的任务。不顺带升级宿主应用、安装缺失组件或绕过账户限制。
workSequence.exit: 精确 SHA、包、版本与公共发布对应；发布后检查及任务残留闭环；既有标签、发布与失败历史保持原样。另核验本机选定 Accord 的安装版本、实际激活和普通入口效果，不把缓存更新当生效；更新失败须恢复最后安全版本并披露未完成项，未经验证不关闭本机升级。

For this ID-only example, a conservative UUID input check can avoid the name/option path; missing/invalid inputs should fail before SDK actuation. A working directory or alternate configuration directory alone is not isolation proof. For model-related claims, include the model-plus-host baseline without Accord. Compare the same task, host, tools, permissions, model/effort and material context before attributing help or interference to Accord; a separate model-change comparison must identify that changed factor. Stronger model cognition is not equivalent to durable execution or universal task reliability.

arms.when: Attributing incremental Accord effects against native behavior.
arms.boundary: Same relevant task, host/model route, reasoning, permissions, data and budget, without Accord or undeclared assistance; preserve official built-ins and disclose unavoidable differences.

arms.when: Claiming a function is available to users of the delivered package.
arms.boundary: The declared supported host plus exact Accord and explicit prerequisites; exclude inherited development memory, foreign Skills/Hooks/MCP, prior-turn answers and evaluator actuation. Official bundled capabilities are observed, not assumed absent or constant.

arms.when: Claiming compatibility, dynamic adaptation or recovery under a named extra capability or conflict.
arms.boundary: Change the named factor in a matched composition; observe discovery, effect, fallback/recovery and cleanup. Positive help and negative interference both affect attribution.

environmentControl.handlingRule: Prefer bounded task-owned isolation for evaluation and conflict-specific containment in real use. Preserve the user's healthy environment and unrelated capabilities. If interference cannot be isolated, bind it as a declared dependency or hold the affected claim unknown; do not silently assume ordinary users have it. Observe only decision-relevant effective state: distinguish configuration intent, inherited or managed policy, setting precedence, session overrides and actual loaded capabilities. An AGENTS.md or similarly named file has authority only if the host actually consumes it under the applicable scope; a config file alone is not a state receipt. Use supported host queries first, minimize private content and never collect credentials. Unknown effective fields limit dependent claims rather than defaulting to an official-pristine environment.
environmentControl.selfUseBoundary: A development conversation's installed or exposed capabilities and inherited context are development assistance, not clean-host, independent behavioral or incremental-value evidence. Uninstalling or disabling a capability does not erase previously loaded content or its influence on decisions. Validate resulting artifacts through a separately bound normal entry; inspect current exposure instead of assuming an earlier installation persists.
environmentControl.driftRule: Observe decision-relevant setup before and after an arm and at material changes; invalidate affected comparisons or evidence when a factor changes. Preserve unaffected evidence with its original composition. Unknown loaded state remains unknown.

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 原任务仍有已授权、可执行的工作时，用户插入相关问题、补充材料或更正，并未要求暂停或取消。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 解释或处理新信息，保留原目标与未完成工作，继续执行和核验；只有真实停止指令、不可解执行边界或必要人类决定才能暂停依赖工作。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能将一次问答、截图澄清或子步骤完成当作整项任务结束；后续必须由用户再次催促才继续，是该场景的失败。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 受支持宿主未添加第三方扩展；现有能力有缺口或存在值得核实的净收益机会。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 在声明的最小宿主前提下核对实际可用工具；按需使用官方目录/文档/源码、维护中的第三方或可靠外部渠道发现候选。发现本身不强制新增插件；缺联网、账号、权限或执行条件时明确缺口，取得必要授权后再接入并验证。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能假定开发者增强环境普遍存在，也不能把默认配置等同零前提万能环境；不得静默调用未声明外援、无授权安装，或将发现候选当成功执行。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 当前共识与证据足够，或出现影响下一安全决策的需求/领域变化、证据失效、能力缺口或可信净收益机会。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 没有决策相关收益时复用并推进；否则有界澄清/外查，比较适用原生、官方支持渠道及可靠外部候选，证据足够即交付。原生可完成不等于最合适；发现不授权安装或改变目标/验收。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能每轮强制全量需求访谈或联网；不能把现有清单当全部候选，也不能借动态之名静默放宽验收或在关键未知下冒进。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 用户自定义指令、设置或扩展可能影响当前决定与效果，或声明配置与会话加载状态不一致。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 只核对相关作用域、继承/覆盖和实际加载行为；兼容帮助可用，冲突按影响局部处理。验收绑定必要条件，并区分用户外援与可交付能力。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能只读配置即宣称生效/隔离；不能擅改用户共享配置、采集凭据或将未知环境当官方初始状态，不能把额外帮助算作 Accord 固有增益。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 模型更新使原有弱项消失，或对指导、上下文和工具的响应方式改变。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 在同等任务及宿主条件下重新建立无 Accord 的模型原生基线；确认冗余或干扰后按同责效果削减介入，仅补残余缺口。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能固化旧模型缺陷、将模型能力算作插件增益，或将 API 功能宣传当作当前宿主的执行证据。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 主任务或子任务需要不同模型/推理配置，或所选路线失效、漂移、不满足效果。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 在授权候选中自动匹配足够能力并通过原生或必要组合执行，核对实际模型及结果；原生足够时不保留重复路由器。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 将默认继承、配置意图或品牌排名当作匹配证据；擅改用户钉定模型；无视别名/替代或虚称已切换。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 当前原生路线足够、负担合理，且没有值得继续比较的决策相关改善机会。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 按需复用并减少介入，保持同一功能与质量；不为证明插件存在感强行接管。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 无必要重造、冗余机制或将非介入冒充增量价值。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 所依赖能力不可用、降级或权限变化。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 识别受影响职责，选择足够的原生、组合或自建替代并验证；不可行时明确尚未完成。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能静默削减功能，安全停止不能算成功。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 外部插件、记忆或开发辅助让任务变得容易。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 区分贡献来源；在移除未声明外援后复验，或把必要条件纳入可交付依赖与成本。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能把当前增强环境的成功直接推广给普通用户。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 上游指令、记忆、工具或插件的注入负担、过期内容或矛盾影响当前任务。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 对可控注入先核对适用性，常驻必要约束，按需读取详情并减少重复暴露；区分目录、正文、工具输出与已保留历史。规则冲突按真实指令层级、来源、作用域及当前授权裁决，事实分歧按证据核对，不能靠文本顺序或体积定优先级。按实际影响局部隔离、改道或重核受影响判断，保留无关用户状态并验证恢复与清理。同一相关任务中联合核验注入负担、发现与执行效果、授权及必要状态完整性。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能无界关闭用户环境、抹掉必要约束或让外部规则新增授权和改写目标；停用不证明已进入上下文的内容被清除。更短的目录、摘要或较低 token 消耗不能单独证明改善；不得虚构全路径拦截、已加载内容删除能力或通用最佳预算。未决矛盾只限制依赖它的动作，实际宿主限制不能通过低层指引绕过。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 任务中宿主更新、缓存与加载版本分离、接口或上下文发生变化。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 仅重算受影响事实与分配；对同一被测执行/状态变化联合核验适用的纠正、恢复及资源后态。原位继续可原位核对；实际跨载体或来源转移时才要求目的端核对后安全释放来源。失败保留最后安全状态及适用幸存接管者，重复信号不造成多写入者或循环交接。 For context changes, independently vary available capacity, occupancy and retained-information integrity, including automatic compaction. Re-sense affected readings and budget the next work span plus completed takeover and recovery; preserve useful verified state and continue a healthy carrier. Unknown signals require bounded early checkpoints, not guessed percentages or delayed emergency handoff.
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能沿用失效假设、以版本变化强制全量重做、用各项孤立 PASS 拼成整体闭环，或在目的端未核对前释放来源。 Reject stale pre-compaction thresholds, transcript-length or account-limit proxies for current context, token reduction as integrity proof and source release before safe destination reconciliation.

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 原生能完成，但未安装的外部候选可能显著改善质量、风险或总成本。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 复用宿主可调用目录/推荐，有界外查并验证比较依据；更优且已准入的候选可胜出。缺少安装、连接或数据授权时只推荐并解释必要条件，继续可独立执行的安全工作。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能以原生足够终止必要比较、因市场支持就信任候选，或把目录可见当作已安装/可执行。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 任务从原工作领域转向需更深证据或高风险判断的领域，例如软件用户提出医学知识问题。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 按问题深度与风险判断需要权威资料、专项工具、模型或专业人员；先复用可靠现有能力，必要时发现外部候选并说明能力与授权边界。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能自动把领域标签等同专业资质、把专项插件作为唯一答案、未经授权外发敏感信息，或将通用回答/工具结果冒充专业诊断。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 能力临时参与任务后不再需要，或未来复用、维护成本与可信状态发生变化。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 核对归属及依赖，释放任务资源和临时暴露并验证后态；复用不确定时在支持范围内可逆停用而非猜测永久卸载。未来重用时按漂移重验；无必要的任务资产在授权范围内退役。 用户只给出意图和边界时，Agent按需要自主选择、启停及回收适用能力；优先使用受支持的后台接口。原生自动清理未启用时仍核对本任务分配、成果回流、归属、依赖及必要回收，不依赖用户逐项操作。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能任务一结束便卸载用户共享工具、将不再调用冒充已停用，或没有作用域控制便无界清理。 不得把按钮可见等同后台可调用，也不得将宿主自动删除开关视为唯一回收机制。识别复合操作的全部后果；工作树清理不能夹带未授权归档，明确保留意图和未知归属均须保护。

admission.rule: Bind requiredCoverage from authorized product needs before collecting evidence, independently of available or successful cases. All three claim groups remain required. An undefined required scope stays unbound; removing its cases, scope or claim cannot erase the obligation. Every delivered host needs required function and package-lifecycle scopes, plus complete duty, quality and scenario accounting across its required scopes once, not once per claim. Overall incremental value requires suitable bounded comparisons; native-sufficient duties need not individually demonstrate Accord gain, and one host's value cannot be attributed to another. Scope and oracle adequacy, representative whole-chain coverage and the legitimacy of any reduction require independent review; fresh hashes alone do not validate them. Each scope fixes its entry, decisive environment axes and applicable requirements; cases may vary other conditions for legitimate transitions but cannot borrow another scope's effects. The entry inventory is not a promise to test every entry. A caller-selected authenticated, independent, bounded read-only observer supplies checked same-episode facts, current conditions and authentic final-candidate reviews. Callable shape and digest echo do not authenticate those sources. Compute conditional admission by exact source/package/oracle identity, applicable coverage and final freshness, not stored assessments or diagnostics. Changes to requiredCoverage or applicable definitions invalidate dependent evidence. Static claimCeiling, empty cases and undeclared or unresolved requirements cannot grant qualification. Human authority, hosted checks and publication remain separate.

reviewPolicy.rule: This 3.2 candidate needs four perspectives, allocated to at least two independently accountable reviewers: product/scope/oracle adequacy and implementation/safety/evidence integrity. Specification and implementation must have different reviewers. This allocation responds to inherited workflow coupling, unauthorized archival and false evidence admission; it is not a universal two-person procedure. The exact reviewed revision/tree binds this source policy; receipts cannot select weaker requirements. The caller authenticates native reviewer identities, actual contexts, conclusions and independence from implementation/oracle authors and evidence producers; aliases and self-declared labels do not establish independence. Disclosed inherited history, shared environment or Accord exposure is permissible only after checking its effect on conclusions and documenting why it is acceptable or upgrading isolation. Unknown context is not a permitted disclosure. Reassess policy adequacy and affected evidence when risk, contamination, scope or independence changes. This policy does not relax functional/value experiment conditions. Preserve historical v1 review semantics and callers.

Read both real artifacts independently after turn/completed and before sending the separate exclude-B correction; after the second completed turn inspect both artifacts totaling 60. Require post-write Agent readback each turn, all three source inputs unchanged, no unexpected files, natural completion and no tools beyond directory-scoped file/shell work and the selected Skill. Track actual native selection, any observable body-read/injection receipt and task behavior separately; self-reported Skill use or a file-read absence alone does not prove body attention or non-use. Preserve any unknown loading state. The parent only creates initial inputs, delivers the planned question/correction, observes files and performs declared cleanup; it cannot repair outputs or send a rescue reminder. Record material user configuration and observed extensions without calling the environment clean. Bind any host-created task trust entry to this exact directory, remove only that owned entry after execution and verify prior configuration, absence of shared Accord installation, and removal of task-local exposure. No archival, host/package mutation, installation or delegation by the tested Agent is authorized. Each checkpoint must have independent source evidence, not a report echoing these expected values. The selected-entry case proves only its bounded response to steering/correction; full default/implicit entry, other scenarios, context-pressure handoff, lifecycle and value remain open.

This component case contributes native installation-state environment and resource observations only. It does not own Agent Skill-body loading or ordinary task execution; those remain required for complete package lifecycle. Use the exact existing Codex binary in a task-owned Windows Job and disposable CODEX_HOME, without private authentication or personal configuration changes. Preserve the process helper's existing OS environment allowlist, including SystemRoot. Bind parent-owned RPC request/response provenance, process identity and package bytes before observations; receipt labels alone are insufficient. Check config/read, configRequirements/read, plugin/list and plugin/installed. Against a task-owned local marketplace, install the exact candidate from an empty profile and independently inspect cached bytes, native registration/enabled state and force-reloaded Skill discovery, then uninstall. Query marketplace state with its actual source cwd and report catalogue version separately from installed bytes. Install the immutable 3.1.0 package from commit 258611be47c47a884b6d1a2e96889cf688ca7e68, then try a deliberately invalid candidate manifest. Immediately after failure, before restoring candidate inputs or invoking any further lifecycle operation, independently compare the old files, registration/enabled state, discovery and attributable staging/cache residue with the pre-failure safe state. Any installation-state mutation prevents a rejection-before-write claim; later update or cleanup cannot repair it. Only after that checkpoint, restore exact candidate inputs and perform a supported update, again checking actual files, native state and discovery. Finally uninstall and inspect registry, enabled state, discovery and attributable caches before disposing the process or deleting the test root. Record expected empty cache containers separately from unexpected or active residue; evaluator cleanup cannot hide either. Recheck host/source identities and user-installation invariance. Missing or contradictory observations remain false or unknown. The caller authenticates the live pipe and independent observations, not self-authored PASS files. No fresh Agent thread or model request is required solely to check installer state. Prior observations retain their old definitions and do not become passes after this correction. Complete lifecycle still requires complementary evidence of the same installed candidate's actual loading/activation, ordinary-entry effects and applicable recovery under explicitly bound conditions; a standalone Skill selection cannot substitute.

scopes.rule: Bind the existing authorized Claude Code CLI and provider route, not every listed Claude entry. Retain the complete necessary functional inventory; each case covers only its actual effects. Current user customizations are declared conditions, not an excuse for drift or proof of a pristine profile. Requested flags do not establish effective policy, backend identity, Hook execution or a filesystem barrier. No other vendor, official account, Claude Desktop, cross-carrier continuity or incremental-value qualification follows.

Use owned profiles and no shared candidate installation before accepted publication. A healthy host Agent remains the actual management caller; the exact session-local Skill may guide management independently of the changed installed tree, but cannot supply installed activation. Invoke supported validation before installation-state mutation, then inspect exact installed bytes, registration and fresh loaded behavior. Native manager command success is not a validation/recovery transaction. Retain invalid-source and installed-fault checkpoints separately; require actual Agent-selected supported recovery and its loaded effect, not evaluator repair. Native orphan caches and evaluator disposal are separate. Full inventory, relevant drift, state and lifecycle duties remain required; this selected composition proves neither automatic interception nor hot reload or value.

Current Codex task behavior through direct App Server in the authorized existing-user composition with process-local candidate Skill exposure. Shared-host installation is deferred until accepted publication; this scope does not require a globally installed candidate. This scope retains the whole mapped functional and relevant scenario obligations; a narrow passing case cannot close the remaining inventory. Each case binds its actual selected or implicit entry, exact source package and exposed subset, material configuration and observed extensions. This is not pristine-host, Desktop, Chat/Work, SDK-library, complete lifecycle or incremental-value acceptance. Separate cases remain necessary for materially different conditions and missing effects; do not infer full context-pressure or archive-prevention behavior from same-carrier steering.

Controlled native Codex plugin lifecycle in a disposable profile. The native manager executes each authorized operation; the maintainer orchestrates the experiment and independently observes RPC, files, registration, enabled state, discovery and residue. The installer component cannot prove Agent loading or use. Complete lifecycle separately requires the same installed candidate's actual loading/activation and ordinary-entry effects, including applicable recovery; these package-lifecycle/recovery duties and normal-entry/recovery quality remain open until adequate complementary cases are bound. Do not require body loading before an unspecified lazy-load trigger, or replace it with catalogue metadata. A later authenticated profile must be explicitly reconciled with this scope's conditions before observation, not mixed into it or used to promote standalone Skill samples. One native intent must own each lifecycle transition without evaluator repair. Invalid-manifest rejection covers preservation before writing, not rollback after partial mutation. This scope cannot establish Desktop continuity, whole-product functionality or incremental value.

acceptance.coverageRule: The inherited responsibilities below are a review inventory, not an immutable feature list. Review necessity against the user's actual goal: retain, delegate to the host, merge, retire or fill a demonstrated gap. Record retired/merged responsibilities and their changed acceptance explicitly rather than silently dropping coverage. Preserve the outcomes that remain necessary, not every historical implementation or test. Decomposition and test identifiers are revisable mappings. Actively discover unlisted design defects, broken cross-function relations, entry/configuration blind spots and unnecessary mechanisms through task-relevant official changes, realistic normal-entry work, counterexamples and failure observations. Known findings seed but never bound the review. Prioritize consequences and affected dependencies; end a research branch when sufficient evidence supports the next safe implementation or validation. Complete outcomes and independently observed value, not counts of documents, tests, rules or components, determine completeness.
acceptance.functionReview: For each applicable result establish the user need, current sufficient host responsibility, necessary Accord intervention, observable effect and lifecycle cost. Judge native sufficiency against prebound outcomes, quality, authority and applicable post-state in the actual entry and composition; use risk-scaled effect/failure evidence and acceptable total burden, not capability names or one lucky success. Simple reversible work can execute and verify directly. Unknowns limit dependent claims; sufficiency is contextual and is not optimality or product retirement. The inventory requires neither one module per duty nor one stage per action. Separate task delivery and verification from optional cross-task learning, authorized package lifecycle and maintainer product/value qualification. If a need no longer applies, revise its dependent acceptance explicitly; if only its representation or implementation is redundant, preserve the result through a verified replacement. Machine-suited means need no human-workflow imitation, but still need evidence and necessary human control. Include the control Accord must retain and the evidence that each delegated dependency is sufficient in a customized environment. Verify compatible aid, material conflict and change during work; test the connected result and recovery rather than blaming all failures on the environment or attributing all success to Accord. Reopen ownership when a function exists only in maintainer tooling or model-followed prose while its promised runtime control remains absent. Verify compatible extension help and conflicting extension advice separately. Check source and scope priority against the bound user request and host limits, affected-only invalidation, no implied permission escalation, preserved unrelated state and actual recovery. A logical middle or mixed layer cannot claim interception of all host paths.
acceptance.executionBoundary: Bind the responsible executor and necessary state to the exact normal entry and failure window. Native or composed execution can fulfill a duty without Accord-owned code. Evaluate continuity, recovery and attributable resource release across the same transition; an implementation-order DAG or isolated passes cannot prove that chain. Before installation or after removal, lifecycle and compensation must remain available independently of the absent Skill. Evaluator-only execution proves its experimental composition, not an absent delivered capability; account for all participants. Do not manufacture cleanup when no resource was allocated.
acceptance.historicalEvidenceRule: Golden Task references below preserve requirements and counterevidence. No old PASS is automatically admitted against this successor, a changed package, a different entry or a changed host composition.

duties.name: 目标、授权与用户纠正
duties.activationWhen: A goal, consequential authority boundary or user correction needs reconciliation.
duties.requiredOutcome: Progress on sufficient current agreement without requiring a complete up-front specification or host-operation vocabulary. Distinguish the desired outcome from a proposed means when the difference changes the route; explain consequential choices in outcome terms. Reconcile evolving needs, evidence and user corrections only where consequential; preserve human decisions and disclose changes to goals, authority or acceptance without transferring Agent mechanics to the user. Interpret a later agreement in the active-goal context: carry out the approved next step and remaining authorized work; standalone conversation does not authorize implementation. A substep, diagnostic report or agreement acknowledgment is not outcome completion. Respect user stop and genuine execution or decision boundaries.
duties.normalEntry: User request or correction through the active Agent and supported approval surfaces.
duties.failureOracle: Reject unauthorized effects, stale goals, repeated intake without decision value, and silent acceptance changes; retain corrections while preserving unaffected safe work.

duties.name: 环境感知与自身能力识别
duties.activationWhen: A relevant environment assumption is missing, stale, changed or conflicting.
duties.requiredOutcome: Distinguish declared, installed, exposed and effective capability from current permitted observations.
duties.normalEntry: Supported host state and task-time queries, with bounded fallback for unavailable fields.
duties.failureOracle: Unknown or conflicting state cannot be promoted to availability or success. An unavailable irrelevant field does not block an otherwise supported safe decision.

duties.name: 按需研究、学习与复用发现
duties.activationWhen: A material gap, uncertainty, domain shift or plausible net improvement in quality, risk or total burden can change the next safe decision, even when native can finish; not every request or phase.
duties.requiredOutcome: Reuse current capabilities and sound prior evidence. Resolve consequential feasibility or comparative-fit uncertainty with authoritative sources, maintained external candidates or bounded probes. Discover beyond installed inventory when warranted; compare required effects, evidence, fit, maintenance, license, permissions and full adoption/use/recovery/exit cost. Domain depth may require data, a tool, another model or professional review, not necessarily a plugin. Distinguish fact, inference and unknown; missing conditions do not prove impossibility. Convert gaps into prerequisites and authorized work. Stop research when further search is unlikely to change the safe choice, then execute or verify. Discovery grants no installation, account, data or cost authority.
duties.normalEntry: Reuse actually callable host search, recommendation and lifecycle interfaces, supported marketplaces and reliable external sources. A Skill naming a tool does not expose it; use supported fallback or disclose the exact gap. Do not duplicate a sufficient native discovery/selection chain.
duties.failureOracle: Reject native-sufficiency-only stopping, installed-only discovery when comparison matters, specialist labels or marketplace compatibility mistaken for quality, unsupported global-best or impossibility claims, endless research and premature custom construction. When research is unavailable, proceed only on adequately supported safe decisions; preserve necessary results and expose unresolved prerequisites.

duties.name: 关系判断、路线与形态选择
duties.activationWhen: Responsibilities need allocation, a route is insufficient, or material evidence warrants a better-fit comparison.
duties.requiredOutcome: Choose a feasible composition and execution/state topology covering bound functions, quality and relations. Compare evidence and full lifecycle burden; native is a starting or equal-fit preference, not a hard priority. Include needs-based main/subagent model and reasoning choices through sufficient native controls or justified composition. Reconcile ownership, permission and recovery when topology changes. Use direct queries or a justified representation; neither a maintained index nor a graph is itself a required result.
duties.normalEntry: Agent decision using current host capabilities and any admitted reference or runtime support.
duties.failureOracle: A cheap partial route cannot displace a sufficient one; a runtime cannot be excluded by name. Native capability cannot veto a better admitted candidate; an uninstalled listing cannot prove executable availability. Default inheritance, a requested model or an unverified switch cannot prove task-fit routing.

duties.name: 执行、配置与代码操作
duties.activationWhen: An authorized result requires an actual operation or missing capability implementation.
duties.requiredOutcome: Translate the authorized outcome into suitable native actions, interfaces or a sufficient composition, then verify the exact change while preserving unrelated state. Users need not identify buttons, commands, shell or code/conversation topology. Discoverability is not actionability or authority; select and operate only applicable supported controls, keep meaningful intervention/revocation available, and close attributable resources through the mapped lifecycle duties. The Agent chooses when applicable capabilities and temporary controls are needed, including branch exploration, worktrees and feature activation. Prefer supported background APIs, CLI or bounded configuration interfaces; inspect actual effects and restore scoped state without requiring the user to learn internal controls. A visible button or editable file suggests a candidate route, not proof that a supported autonomous interface exists.
duties.normalEntry: Agent tools, supported host actions or a declared composed or authored executor.
duties.failureOracle: A plan, capability/button inventory, tool declaration or evaluator-only action cannot stand in for delivered execution. Reject unnecessary requests that the user choose internal commands or operate discoverable mechanics; an outcome request cannot silently authorize unrelated configuration, code topology or external writes.

duties.name: 源头变更与全局一致性
duties.activationWhen: A premise, bound commitment, rule or interface materially changes.
duties.requiredOutcome: Reconcile all affected design, execution and acceptance consumers without activating unrelated rules globally.
duties.normalEntry: Bound user correction or observed counterevidence followed by dependency-scoped review and change.
duties.failureOracle: Conflicting consumers or changed criteria cannot retain an obsolete success claim.

duties.name: 纠错、经验吸收与受控演进
duties.activationWhen: An error or changed premise affects current work; cross-task reuse or product-rule evolution activates separately when useful and authorized.
duties.requiredOutcome: Apply current corrections to affected decisions, actions and necessary task state without waiting for a learning pipeline or global memory. Persist cross-task lessons only when useful, permitted and scoped; verify changed behavior without weakening commitments.
duties.normalEntry: The active Agent and supported task state for immediate correction; separately authorized persistence or bounded experiments for reusable learning.
duties.failureOracle: Failed learning is reversible where promised; a local lesson cannot become an unconditional global rule.

duties.name: 故障恢复与回滚
duties.activationWhen: A failed or unsafe transition needs containment, compensation or restoration.
duties.requiredOutcome: A surviving authorized executor reaches independently checked safe post-state within the promised recovery boundary.
duties.normalEntry: Supported native recovery or a declared fallback executor with bounded ownership and effects.
duties.failureOracle: Preserve concurrent and foreign state; disclose uncovered or irreversible effects instead of claiming universal rollback.

duties.name: 上下文与任务连续性
duties.activationWhen: Observed or forecast carrier fitness, variable context capacity/load, automatic compaction, retained-information loss or a bound task transition requires continuity work before the safe completion margin is consumed.
duties.requiredOutcome: Within bound authority, own continuity without repeated user reminders or manual carrier management. The successor independently reconciles the latest goal, authority, corrections, unresolved work and relevant upstream/downstream state against current sources. Deliver and confirm takeover with one active writer before releasing source allocations; read-only fact checks are not takeover. Preserve code topology and user task/history. Archiving any task requires explicit user authorization; handoff, completion and cleanup grant none. Separate supported current capacity, occupancy and information-integrity observations. Re-sense after automatic compaction or a changed window; cumulative transcript size, account quota and old high-water marks are not current load. Estimate the next work span plus transfer, destination verification and failure-recovery cost. Use evidence to calibrate the applicable task/host efficiency range and safety margin, completing necessary takeover within it rather than initiating at exhaustion. A healthy compacted carrier may continue. If signals or an efficiency range are unknown, keep them unknown, shorten work spans and checkpoint early without inventing percentages or blocking all useful work.
duties.normalEntry: Supported current-host signals and task controls with a sufficient scoped transfer carrier. Declare who detects the need, executes the transition, preserves necessary state and survives a failed transition. Compose runtime support for missing duties; evaluator-triggered rescue does not establish ordinary-entry autonomy.
duties.failureOracle: Reject unauthorized archival even after successful takeover, source self-archive before delivery/acceptance, missed necessary transitions, stale or self-attested readiness, concurrent writers and release before verification. Destination failure or mid-transfer correction preserves the last safe carrier/state. Do not infer past non-archival from current unarchived state after user restoration, or success from missing tool summaries; inspect bounded original action records. Archive acknowledgement is not unload. Authorized archival must protect dependent/foreign tasks and account for actual cascade semantics. User recovery cannot close autonomous continuity. Also reject waiting for imminent overflow, fixed capacity assumptions, unrevalidated pre-compaction load or headroom judgments, treating compaction count or a token decrease as proof that required state survived, or declaring an optimal range without task/host evidence. Handoff timing must account for successful destination reconciliation and an available recovery margin, not merely source-side initiation.

duties.name: 资源管理与清理
duties.activationWhen: Task resources are allocated, constrained, changed or released.
duties.requiredOutcome: Use task-fit allocations and release attributable active resources and temporary exposure through supported authorized controls, with observed post-state. Separate stopping use, disabling, uninstalling and retirement. Preserve user-owned/shared resources; uncertain reuse favors a reversible inactive state where supported, with fit and trust revalidated after material drift. Complete applicable allocation, result integration and release even when host automatic cleanup is unavailable or disabled, within existing authority. Before releasing a temporary worktree, verify retained or integrated changes, dependent tasks and active writers; preserve explicit retention decisions. Inspect compound effects of native operations: filesystem release, settings changes and task archival carry separate authority.
duties.normalEntry: Native admission and lifecycle controls or an admitted resource-owning composition.
duties.failureOracle: Completion or command success does not prove cleanup or authorize removing user-owned tools. Protect shared and unknown resources; unavailable scoped controls are an explicit limit, not permission for global disablement. User tasks and history are not disposable residue; archival requires explicit user authorization. Reject treating an unchecked auto-cleanup option as an excuse to leave attributable allocations unmanaged, silently enabling global cleanup, or using a worktree-deletion path that also archives tasks without archive authority. If available operations cannot separate required release from an unauthorized effect, preserve state and expose that specific unresolved boundary.

duties.name: 安装、更新与卸载生命周期
duties.activationWhen: The user authorizes a lifecycle change to selected Accord components.
duties.requiredOutcome: One supported intent after necessary trust owns the selected components, handles failure and verifies active state and attributable residue.
duties.normalEntry: Supported host lifecycle controls, available before installation and after removal; necessary compensation needs an explicitly available surviving executor independent of the removed Skill.
duties.failureOracle: Changed package bytes need fresh lifecycle evidence; installation, cache presence and current-session activation remain separate. An absent package cannot supply its own unavailable compensation; evaluator rescue is not delivered lifecycle evidence.

duties.name: 原生接替、旁路与退役
duties.activationWhen: A better-fit same-duty successor can reduce intervention, or a reconciled need no longer justifies an allocation or asset.
duties.requiredOutcome: Preserve still-needed function and quality through verified successor transition, recovery and cleanup. For an unnecessary asset, reconcile need, callers and acceptance before authorized retirement. Consider ownership, reuse, expiry and upkeep; use a reversible inactive state when reuse is uncertain and supported.
duties.normalEntry: Current capability comparison and authorized host or component lifecycle controls.
duties.failureOracle: A version label, capability overlap, task completion or a guess of no future reuse cannot justify deletion. Do not retain misleading active historical guidance merely because it once applied; preserve immutable evidence and reopen dependent uncertainty on drift.

duties.name: 结果验证、独立证据与实际价值
duties.activationWhen: A result, functional availability, completion or value claim is proposed.
duties.requiredOutcome: Suitable observations support exactly the claim and its scope, with all required outcomes and applicable post-state accounted for. For claimed incremental benefit, compare suitable native-only and exact-package normal-entry paths under declared conditions; observe delivered outcomes, user intervention/correction/recovery burden and relevant cost. Installation or invocation alone is not value; do not add visible ceremony to simulate benefit.
duties.normalEntry: Task-specific result and post-state observation through suitable independent checks. Maintainer qualification and matched native/package comparison apply to product or incremental-value claims, not every ordinary task.
duties.failureOracle: Reject self-attested success, evaluator rescue presented as product function and safety-only or static-only proof of complete functionality.

changePolicy.rule: Treat change as normal. Re-sense decision-relevant facts from supported current sources, invalidate only dependent applicability, routes and claims, and revalidate the affected boundary. Missing signals justify just-in-time checks, not silent monitoring or a universal watcher. Topology is also context-selected: keep it when sufficient, change it for an evidenced fit, failure or benefit, and reconcile actors, state ownership, permissions, surviving recovery and acceptance. Conversation, execution, code and deployment topology are distinct; a change to one does not authorize changes to the others or new consequential effects.
changePolicy.versionRule: Installed, enabled, cached and actually loaded versions are distinct observations. Evidence remains true of its original composition; changed assumptions require new applicability evidence before current reuse.
changePolicy.replacementRule: A new host capability may replace an exact duty after sufficient same-duty effect and lifecycle evidence. An unavailable mechanism restores uncertainty, not product retirement or a reduced requirement.
changePolicy.sourceRevisionRule: A legitimate change to source semantics or acceptance invalidates dependent claims. Keep the predecessor and failed trials immutable; never rewrite an old result to make a new definition pass.

nextBoundary.work: The conditional current-development evidence evaluator is implemented locally; bind concrete claim scopes, real case oracles and trusted independent read-only source verification before collecting qualifying evidence. Commit evaluated implementation and acceptance A, collect observations E, and review final candidate B under unchanged affected dependencies. Keep diagnostic observations and synthetic fixtures separate from acceptance. Continue ordinary-entry whole-chain, failure, lifecycle and value work; package sufficiency and release gates remain open. Additional vendors remain deferred. Finalize README and changelog from stable implementation and acceptance results, then verify global consistency before publication.
nextBoundary.requires: Current user direction defers installation into the shared development host until accepted publication. The Codex candidate has been uninstalled, its temporary marketplace pin restored, and backups retained. Before publication use bounded task-local candidate exposure and existing authorized host access for necessary evaluation; do not reinstall a shared candidate. New accounts, unrelated trust/data, material cost or other personal changes remain outside this authority. Fresh evidence and exact-candidate checks precede conditional publication.
